_doc: V3 narration: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, language id, voice Maliq Nganjuk (EIcz16yo4q5hJFhNay0n), chosen from a 3-voice Free-plan audition (Widi Wijaya, Maliq, Denas). 'say' = text sent to ElevenLabs, 'text' = subtitle.
